adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 bounded re-review recovered source-supported MIC, sMIC, HC10, and selectivity rows from local material; database activity rows are reconciled except a preserved DBAASP/source conflict for 5-4 against C. parapsilosis and noncanonical sequence-normalization cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP literature links match article metadata. Assay values match Table S8/Fig. 7d except the 5-4 C. parapsilosis row, which remains source_conflict. DBAASP sequence strings collapse noncanonical beta residues and ACPC to X, so assay rows are retained as sequence_modified_not_normalized with Table 1 locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: 50 source-supported activity/toxicity/selectivity rows were recovered from rendered local Table S8, Fig. 7d, and methods context; no database-only row is promoted as primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to background and indirect physicochemical/activity context; no direct membrane-disruption mechanism is claimed for the lead peptides.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_decision: The prior blocking ticket is closed after source-reviewed repair if strict gates pass; residual database conflicts are preserved as cautions rather than hidden.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Merged DBAASP sequence catalog replaces noncanonical beta residue identities and ACPC with X; primary Table 1 preserves the modified sequence notation and amidated C-terminus.
DBAASP assay/experiment rows report 32 ug/mL; local rendered Table S8 and Table S9 support 64 ug/mL for peptide 5-4 against C. parapsilosis.
Curve images were opened for context, but exact per-point curve data were not digitized because source tables and Fig. 7d already provide endpoint values needed for the gate.
